TENSION HEADACHE RELIEF. 😌⠀

Daily tension, stress and just plain everyday life can make it a struggle with headaches. 😒

Tension headaches usually start on the side of the neck and then travel over to the side of the head. If bad enough, they can even be felt into the eyes.

It's commonly caused by strain to muscles, causing spasms and tightness. This leads to tension buildup, and headaches.
 ⠀
So this exercise may be used help to reduce that tension and spasm of these muscles, and knock out neck pain and headaches. 💥🤛⠀

HOW TO GET RELIEF:

1️⃣ Sit with good, upright posture in a chair.
2️⃣ Retract chin and keep eyes level (don't tuck chin to chest).
3️⃣ Form a field goal position with the arms.
4️⃣ Make sure to bring arms backwards, so they're in line with the shoulders!
5️⃣ Slowly, raise the arms upward to form a point (upside down V).
6️⃣ Pull arms down into a W position to further the stretch. 

➡️ Do 10 reps, relax, and repeat 3 times.
